title: One Interact on E, with the story option first
caption: Talk and Chat are one action now, Interact, on E or a tap. When someone has story to move on and things to chat about, Interact opens one menu: the story option first in teal with a Story tag, then the chat topics, then Leave. With only one option it just happens. E now shows on the pin and in the menu wherever Q does.

sections.title: Mio, day 1, the copier fixed
sections.caption: The moment from your report. E opens the menu with the story row focused, and E again tells her.

sections.title: One option: no menu
sections.caption: Kenji before you have met him has only his story, so it starts at once. Mori on day 2 has only chat topics, so Interact goes straight into them.

sections.title: The guard at the gate, before the good morning
sections.caption: The goal says Japanese and a hint under it says how, also after Continue. Interact on him opens Say, and he has no Chat until you have greeted him.
